items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A green HTTP candidate served sauna and the run passed; progress recorded the eleven specified effects in order, including gate-attempt-passed.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed at the fence self-check, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; the run list contained R-1 once for C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: While R-1 was running in a sleeping builder, a second start returned run-in-progress; R-2 progress was null and R-1 progress remained running.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed cycle C-1, starting R-2 for C-1 returned cycle-already-run and R-2 progress was null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started R-1 with a nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run returned not-a-commit and run-progress returned null, with no builder launch.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A committed feature with no scenarios produced an empty-checklist refusal and halted at checklist before self-check or fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A committed plan with an additional unstamped scenario recorded the stamp then halted at stamp for differing identities, with no pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A self-check exiting 1 with golden checklist differs produced a failed run at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail; self-check was the last effect and no fence or regenerate was recorded.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A self-check printing SKIP bb-tools exited 0; its recorded harness-self-check-passed event listed bb-tools among skipped checks.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: Fencing impl and the absent harness/cycles caused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by fail-cycle and a failed fence with reason fence-refused; no builder ran.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: A builder recorded its fenced room: plan and config were present, impl was empty, git had one commit, and rev-list objects contained no impl or harness/cycles paths.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The first red candidate was gated before the second builder launch, which produced a green candidate; the two recorded launches used distinct session identities.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder leaving a green candidate then exiting 1 had its regeneration recorded and the HTTP gate and cycle passed.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder leaving the scope empty produced no regenerate effect; fail-cycle was recorded and the run failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A builder sleeping 30 seconds under a two-second regenerate budget was stopped, and the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A server occupied the configured port; the gate was refused seam-answered-before-boot three times with three gate-refusal effects, then failed for infrastructure, and the launch sentinel was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The suite exited 1; the gate recorded suite-red and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted, while the launch sentinel was absent.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A candidate with executable test.sh and no start.sh recorded gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A green HTTP candidate serving other instead of the sauna marker recorded gate-attempt-failed for identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The builder spawned a delayed write turning its own suite red after exit; the write occurred, but the gate copy passed and install and regenerate recorded the same digest.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: After a red first suite, repair 2 recorded verification-repair and named attempt 1’s evidence root; the second builder listed the clean room, previous candidate and evidence, whose directories and files had no write bits.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Three red candidates produced exactly three builder launches and gate-attempts-exhausted; the model saw only the render request and no file-verdicts effect was recorded.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Researcher code branched on the item and threw for 01-002; file-verdicts contained only 01-001 and measurement filed 01-002 as unreached, with 1 of 2 passing and the run passed.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: One run failed at the fence self-check and a second halted at empty checklist; five seconds later both retained their statuses and identical effect results.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: After a passing run, two successive run-progress queries returned identical run objects and the status remained passed.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The cut probe accepted exactly one argument, the configured HTTP URL, and checked the marker; the gate recorded gate-attempt-passed and the run passed.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate suite created and removed a directory in its scope, then the HTTP gate passed; install and regenerate recorded the same candidate digest.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; harness-self-check-passed listed the entire text after SKIP as the skipped check.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With stdio configured and a green suite, probe and store check, the run passed and gate-attempt-passed recorded 30 seconds, one poll, answered on one, and answered as the context.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe recorded the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30 as its arguments, GATE_STORE outside that room, and no LOYLY variables; the store check received that same path.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A red stdio suite recorded suite-red; its captured environment contained no LOYLY or GATE_STORE variables, and probe and store-check sentinels were absent.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With a single stdio attempt, the probe exited 1 with the specified timeout line; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed with that detail and the store-check sentinel was absent.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With a single stdio attempt, the failing store check produced identity-probe-failed with its FAIL event 7 detail and the cycle failed for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A stdio suite requiring the plan spec at its root-relative path passed the gate, and regenerate and install recorded the same digest.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With stdio configured and no store-check command, the run halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and recorded no gate effect.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs with a failing probe differed only in store-check command arguments one and two; both first self-checks passed and recorded different harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A committed 01-a symlink to ../spec/a was stamped and checklisted as 01-001 and 01-002 with sources under 01-a, and the run passed.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A two-slice plan with PLAN_SLICES=02 recorded only a slice 02 stamp and a checklist containing only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: A configured fixture builder-clojure image was passed as the third argument to both fresh and repair launches; both effects named that image and its digest, and the second attempt passed.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A configuration naming builder-clojure without an images directory returned builder-image-missing; run-progress was null and no builder launched.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two otherwise identical runs on one store both passed with distinct cuts; C-2’s scoreboard named C-1 as previous, and its stamp recorded no new item identities.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The committed harness/probe.sh sourced its adjacent config and checked the served marker; the gate passed and install and regenerate had matching candidate digests.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command received the cut tree, separate candidate and empty evidence directory in the project repository; gate passed with 10 seconds, 20 polls, poll 3 and its probe line, and the candidate launch sentinel stayed absent.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command failed attempt 1 as suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed and wrote proof; the repair builder observed that file mode 444, and attempt 2 passed.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A gate command naming seam-answered-before-boot returned three refused gate effects, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A gate command exiting 2 with infrastructure the world did not come up halted at gate for effect-could-not-run, with no gate result, fail-cycle, or cycle in progress.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three passing runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b recorded three different harness digests; the no-command digest matched SHA-256 of config bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The passing HTTP run produced eleven effects; Grain reader inspection placed each between start and successful completion of its same-named leaf in cycle.v1 or its gate-attempt child tick.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A server returned 503 for its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 with 20 polls and a 10-second budget, and the attempt margin was 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: A red first and green second candidate passed on attempt 2. Grain events show each attempt’s install, self-check and gate inside its own gate-attempt.v1 child of the cycle tick, and repair 2 inside attempt 1’s child.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: Copied the candidate into a temporary folder without a .pi ancestor and ran the HTTP fixture there; gate-attempt-passed and the run passed. The temporary copy was removed.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The judge scored 01-001 pass/booked and 01-002 fail/no receipt; Measurement filed 1 of 2 and the run passed. Grain shows named judge scores in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the cycle tick.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Researcher code returned E-ONE for 01-001 and E-TWO for 01-002; recorded requests show E-ONE in the first judge request and in neither the second researcher nor second judge request.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first researcher request held the fixture scenario, seam and event model; shell evidence showed Linux, the item grading room with clean-room files and impl, and only that room in its parent listing.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The judge gave 01-002 level 2 and feedback without reasoning; progress and Grain showed only 01-001’s score, file-verdicts contained it alone, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with 1 of 2 passing.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: Started with r-1 approved and a different computed rubric digest; progress halted at grader with refused-before-the-cycle naming the digest, after stamp, pin and checklist only, and no builder ran.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The model repeatedly supplied no researcher code for either item; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the run failed at score with score-stage-failed, with no later builder effect.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: Killed the runner and sleeping builder five seconds into its first launch, then restarted on the same store; the run passed, both builder launches recorded the same session identity, and each pre-builder effect and regenerate appeared once.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The recorded first instruction was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair instruction appended only a paragraph naming previous-candidate and attempt 1 gate-evidence paths.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: With the model endpoint unavailable, the run halted at render for effect-could-not-run; progress showed no regenerate, fail-cycle or cycle and the builder was not launched.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: During a sleeping regenerate, progress showed R-1 running with a tick ID, fence and render completed and regenerate running last.
